# A1 Transmission

A1 Transmission is an auto repair shop at 20146 Saticoy Street B1, Winnetka, CA 91306. The shop opened in April 1995 and serves Winnetka and the San Fernando Valley. Phone: (818) 882-5135. Email: Kf6ymf@gmail.com. Hours: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–6:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM–12:00 PM, Sunday closed.

Transmission diagnosis is free unless the transmission must be removed and opened. Transmission repair is backed by a 1-year or 12,000-mile warranty, whichever comes first. The only shop is in Winnetka. Canoga Park is a service area, not a second storefront. Google review replies are signed Young.

## Services

- Automatic and manual transmission rebuild and repair
- Transmission full fluid flush
- Clutch service and repair
- Brake repair and brake system fluid service
- Axle differential repair and drive shaft replacement
- Transfer case and 4x4 repair

## Transmission repair in Winnetka

Page: https://a1transmissionautos.com/transmission-repair-winnetka

A1 Transmission repairs, rebuilds, and replaces automatic and manual transmissions at 20146 Saticoy Street B1, Winnetka, CA 91306. Phone: (818) 882-5135. The shop opened in April 1995. Google review replies are signed Young.

- Diagnosis is free unless the transmission must be removed and opened.
- A rebuild can run $2,000 or more, depending on the vehicle, and usually takes two days or more.
- Warranty is 1 year or 12,000 miles, whichever comes first.
- Almost all makes and models. CVTs are usually replaced rather than rebuilt.
- Towing is usually paid by the customer. There is no in-house financing; the shop can refer a financing company.
- One shop, in Winnetka. It serves Winnetka and the San Fernando Valley. Canoga Park is a service area, not a second shop: https://a1transmissionautos.com/transmission-repair-canoga-park
